methodology: Hand-written citizen personas. Each has a ground-truth structured profile and the SAME situation written three ways: plain (how someone writes a full sentence), telegraphic (comma-separated fragments, how people actually type on a phone), and code_mixed (romanised Indian-language or native script mixed with English). The three phrasings exist to measure extraction robustness — a system that only understands well-formed English is not usable here. Ground-truth profiles are authored, not derived from the system's own output, so extraction accuracy is a genuine measurement. expected_schemes are NOT yet filled in: they require a human to verify entitlements against approved clauses, and no clause in this corpus has been approved.

personas.note: The canonical PM-KISAN / KCC / PMFBY case.

phrasings.plain: I am 33 years old, a farmer in Telangana with 1.5 acres of land in my village. I belong to OBC and my yearly income is about 1.5 lakh.
phrasings.telegraphic: farmer, 33, telangana, 1.5 acres, obc, village, income 1.5 lakh
phrasings.code_mixed: main 33 saal ka kisan hoon, telangana mein 1.5 acres zameen hai, obc, gaon mein rehta hoon, saalana income 1.5 lakh

personas.note: Widow pension and BPL housing. Gender must be inferred from 'widow' and cited.

phrasings.plain: I am a 52 year old widow living in a village in Bihar. I have no land and I hold a BPL card. My yearly income is about 40000 rupees.
phrasings.telegraphic: widow, 52, bihar, no land, bpl card, village, income 40000
phrasings.code_mixed: main 52 saal ki vidhwa hoon, bihar ke gaon mein rehti hoon, koi zameen nahi, bpl card hai, saal ki aamdani 40000 rupaye

personas.note: Post-matric scholarship. Education stage and category both matter.

phrasings.plain: I am a 20 year old woman studying engineering as an undergraduate in Tamil Nadu. I am from the Scheduled Caste community and my family income is 2 lakh a year.
phrasings.telegraphic: student, 20, female, tamil nadu, scheduled caste, undergraduate engineering, family income 2 lakh
phrasings.code_mixed: main 20 saal ki mahila student hoon, tamil nadu mein undergraduate engineering padh rahi hoon, scheduled caste, family income 2 lakh

personas.note: The dependent case. The class belongs to the DAUGHTER, not the parent.

phrasings.plain: I am 44 and a farmer in Andhra Pradesh. I own 2 acres of land in my village and my daughter is in 11th class. I earn about 1.8 lakh a year.
phrasings.telegraphic: farmer, 44, andhra pradesh, 2 acres, village, daughter in class 11, income 1.8 lakh
phrasings.code_mixed: నేను 44 ఏళ్ల రైతుని, ఆంధ్రప్రదేశ్ లో 2 ఎకరాలు ఉన్నాయి, మా అమ్మాయి 11వ తరగతి, గ్రామంలో ఉంటాను, ఆదాయం 1.8 లక్ష

personas.note: Labour welfare board schemes. 'mazdoor' must map to labourer.

phrasings.plain: I am 38 years old and work as a construction worker in a city in Uttar Pradesh. I have a BPL card and earn around 96000 rupees a year.
phrasings.telegraphic: construction worker, 38, uttar pradesh, city, bpl, income 96000
phrasings.code_mixed: main 38 saal ka mazdoor hoon, uttar pradesh ke shahar mein kaam karta hoon, bpl card hai, saal ki aamdani 96000

personas.note: Pre-matric scholarship. ST category, school class on the applicant themselves.

phrasings.plain: I am 14 years old and study in class 9 at a village school in Odisha. I belong to a Scheduled Tribe and my family income is 90000 rupees a year.
phrasings.telegraphic: student, 14, odisha, class 9, scheduled tribe, village, family income 90000
phrasings.code_mixed: main 14 saal ka student hoon, odisha ke gaon mein kaksha 9 mein padhta hoon, scheduled tribe, ghar ki aamdani 90000

personas.note: Disability pension. 'divyang' is the common romanised term.

phrasings.plain: I am 34, I live in a village in Maharashtra and I am differently abled. I hold a BPL card and my income is around 60000 rupees a year.
phrasings.telegraphic: 34, maharashtra, village, differently abled, bpl, income 60000
phrasings.code_mixed: main 34 saal ka hoon, maharashtra ke gaon mein rehta hoon, divyang hoon, bpl card hai, aamdani 60000

personas.note: Handloom and women's entrepreneurship. Gender is stated, not inferred.

phrasings.plain: I am a 41 year old woman working as a handloom weaver in a village in Gujarat. I am OBC and earn about 1.2 lakh a year.
phrasings.telegraphic: weaver, 41, female, gujarat, village, obc, income 1.2 lakh
phrasings.code_mixed: main 41 saal ki mahila hoon, gujarat ke gaon mein handloom bunkar ka kaam karti hoon, obc, saal ki aamdani 1.2 lakh

personas.note: PM SVANidhi. Urban, no land, small trade.

phrasings.plain: I am 39 and run a street vending stall in Delhi city. I make around 1.4 lakh in a year.
phrasings.telegraphic: street vendor, 39, delhi, city, income 1.4 lakh
phrasings.code_mixed: main 39 saal ka hoon, delhi shahar mein street vendor hoon, saal ki aamdani 1.4 lakh

personas.note: Old-age pension. Age is the deciding field and must not be confused with income.

phrasings.plain: I am 68 years old and a senior citizen living in a village in Kerala. I own no land, I have a BPL card, and my income is about 30000 rupees a year.
phrasings.telegraphic: senior citizen, 68, kerala, village, no land, bpl, income 30000
phrasings.code_mixed: main 68 saal ka senior citizen hoon, kerala ke gaon mein rehta hoon, koi zameen nahi, bpl card hai, aamdani 30000

gold_set_corrections: ap-farmer-daughter-class11 / code_mixed originally omitted income, which the plain and telegraphic phrasings both state. The harness reported it as an extraction miss; it was a gold-set inconsistency. Income added so all three phrasings carry the same facts.

sc-engineering-student / code_mixed originally conveyed gender only through the Hindi feminine verb form 'ki'. Inferring gender from grammatical agreement is too fragile to rely on, so the phrasing now states 'mahila' explicitly.
